rows.en: －　Eve of the final exam...　－＝－　Monitor Room　－
＊Sakaki＊＠００５＿００１Final check complete. Elan Ship￥construction is at 99 percent.＝＠００５＿００２Now all that's left is some￥fine-tuning... and choosing￥the crew.
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿００３Yeah.￥We're in the home stretch now.
＊Sakaki＊＠００５＿００４What's wrong?￥＠００５＿００５You've got bags under your eyes.
＊Sakaki＊＠００５＿００６You haven't been sleeping￥lately, have you?
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿００７I'm not even the one going...￥but I'm too wound up to sleep.
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿００８I'm like a little kid...
＊Sakaki＊＠００５＿００９I know how you feel.
＊Sakaki＊＠００５＿０１０So, how about it?￥What's your impression?
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０１１They've shown me better results￥than I ever expected.＝＠００５＿０１２Who makes the cut tomorrow￥doesn't really matter.

＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０１３We lost our home planet, but￥humanity survived this far...＝＠００５＿０１４Those chosen, and those left￥behind... I believe they all￥share the same hope.＝＠００５＿０１５No... maybe it's more accurate￥to say I want to believe it...
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０１６Well, tomorrow's a big day.￥Let's get some rest.
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０１７It won't look good if we're￥half asleep.
－　The next day　－
＊＊－　The Elan Ship...?!　－
＊＊－　It's exploding!!　－
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０１８What's the situation?! Report!!
＊Sakaki＊＠００５＿０１９15 percent damage to the Elan￥Ship's engine control room!＝＠００５＿０２０And... there's a fire spreading!￥The whole crew is working on￥repairs.
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０２１Damn it!￥I can't believe they did it!
＊Sakaki＊＠００５＿０２２What?
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０２３The truth is, we'd gotten word￥of a sabotage plot.
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０２４Jealousy from those left behind,￥or thugs who profit from the￥way things are...＝＠００５＿０２５Either way...￥this is my fault!!
＊Narusawa＊＠００５＿０２６I'm joining the repair effort!!￥You make sure the candidates￥are safe!!
＊Sakaki＊＠００５＿０２７Ah! Where are you going?!￥Wait a minute!
＊Sakaki＊...＝＠００６＿００１He's gone...
＊Sakaki＊...＝＠００６＿００２Honestly... he always jumps￥the gun.
＊Sakaki＊＠００６＿００３This is Sakaki. There's been a￥change of plans...
－　Meeting Room　－
＊Sakaki＊＠００６＿００４That's where things stand.＝＠００６＿００５The work crews are doing repairs￥right now, but things aren't￥looking good.
＊Sakaki＊＠００６＿００６To turn this around, we need￥staff with specialized skills.＝＠００６＿００７You understand what I'm saying,￥don't you?
＊Sakaki＊＠００６＿００９Putting candidates in danger...￥I'm a failure as a supervisor...
＊Sakaki＊＠００６＿０１０but on behalf of humanity...￥of everyone left behind,￥I'm asking all of you.
＊Sakaki＊＠００６＿０１１Please save the ship to Elan...￥Save our "hope"...
